text.p: You will have to face financial problems you've been trying to ignore the past weeks hoping they'll go away. You can't bury your head ostrich-like and think that's that. Face the music, the sooner the better. People do make mistakes and you won't be the first one to have misjudged the market or the demands of a client. Chalk it down to experience. Your partners will understand. They could not possibly have a perfect track record either. Just vow to return to the salt mines immediately and stick your nose to the grindstone as long as it takes for things to go right again.

You must get your relevant documents and accounting ledgers ready for the taxmen cometh. You will also be dealing with insurance people now to settle some claims your business will be making soon. Be sure you're totally "hands on" on this matter for you cannot delegate such a sensitive task. Spend time, too, with your computer programmers and managers. Find out why the equipment is developing glitches and hitches. Tell them to get their act together or else.

There's no need to go off in a blue funk just because you find out that a project has been scrapped. Show them your lack of resentment and rancour by preparing new proposals with suggestions on how to raise the funds to finance them. Keep up a cheerful mien and you'll recover from your disappointment fast. Complaining and putting on a long face will just further serve to alienate management and their support. Things will take a turn for the better after the 26th.

You fly in a holding pattern now. Just be happy merely staying aloft. This week promises a rough and bumpy ride up the corporate road. Competition may be extra fierce and the fight could turn nasty. You need not resort to dirty tricks yourself. Keep to the straight and narrow road of doing what's right and you'll soon emerge in the light. There will be great temptation to give your adversary tit for tat, but if they don't play by the rules, be sure you do. Later, you'll be glad you did.

You are still overly optimistic and prone to overcalculating your chances on just about everything. You want to jump feet first into projects and proposals where angels would fear to tread. Mars and Venus, the planets of self-assertion and wealth, give you this impetus. Try to tone down your enthusiasm a bit and stop to think. If the project is worthwhile, you can afford to wait while you fine tune your plans and scan facts and figures. Besides, the planet of commerce which rules over your horoscope sector of money is "out to lunch" and won't resume its normal course until after the 26th.

People around you seem sluggish and slow to react to your orders and suggestions. Like they're stuck in glue. Prodding doesn't seem to help and neither does scolding. You'll have to offer more attractive incentives. Or you could just wait until your planet, Mercury, moves in a "direct" motion after the 26th. For now, initiate no new projects and sign no contracts which will commit you to long term jobs. This time is best used to review where you've been and how you've fared.

This is hardly the best of time for you. You seem to be slogging through thick jungle underbrush just to accomplish the most minimal of work requirements. It's not the time to be dealing with big groups or organisations. Even those who would have helped you readily in the past now seem scarce and elusive. Better not insist on your way now. Feel your way around and keep a finger to the wind to see which way it's blowing. Contracts should not be signed until after the 26th. Prepare for delays and confusion.

You could be overly trusting now, something that's not quite like you. It there's a shrewdie in the zodiac wheel, it would easily be you. But it would seem that your guard is down and people take advantage of you. No, you can't believe this is possible because you can smell a scam a hundred yards aways. But some people can employ extremely subtle ways now to escape your sensitive detection. Stay alert anyway. The regretable part is that betrayal may come under the guise of friendly concern from someone you've always trusted. Prepare for this blow. This period may bring a very expensive lesson in friendship.

You are prone to speechifying and lecturing your employees and sometimes even colleagues. Try to soft-pedal this tendency now for you may overstep your authority and clash with people rungs above you in the corporate ladder. Of course you'll scream about your right to be heard. You may also hold the moral high ground. But so what, if you act so sanctimoniously that you alienate the very people who could have helped you in the first place? See if you can eat some humble pie for now. Or, at the very least, keep quiet. A tall order, for sure, but not an impossible one.

You are ruled by the planet of restriction and responsibility and you life is ruled by these two tenets. But this period can be more than usually bleak because of even more demands made upon you by planetary forces. You will feel as if the cosmic collector is even more demanding and stringent now. You have weathered worse things, remember. You'll get through the trials of this period, too. Just stop worrying and meet challenges head-on. You'll win.

You will wonder what happened to the gravity points and centres of your seemingly ordered universe. Now, it's as if "chaos-theory" holds sway. Nothing makes sense. Friends who you trusted are unreliable and, worse, turn against you. For what reason you don't know. Retreat from the office intramurals to think by yourself. Sort matters out without the well-meaning advice of relatives. You need objectivity and dispassion. Basic attributes of people of your zodiac sign which may sadly be in short supply. Persevere and you'll make sense of what's befallen you.

You will be provided by fate and fortune with more than ample opportunity to strut your stuff and get the accolades you so richly deserve. But this gift does not come without strings attached. Yes, you may get that promotion now and lots of media attention if that's possible - but you'll lose your privacy in the process. Now you'll know what it is to live in a fish bowl. You may prefer your anonymity in the ocean depths. But there's a trade-off here. You give up your privacy for the rewards of public acclaim. There is no such thing as a free lunch. "You pays your money and you takes your choice." This is the rule in the canteen of the universe.
